labels.species: Neutropenic mice; disseminated candidiasis model; C. albicans strains K1, W2, 580, 98-210, 1490, 5810, 2-76, 2183, 98-17, 98-234. Regimen note uses Isolate K-1.
labels.matrix: pair of kidneys for the response endpoint; exposure matrix NOT_FOUND
labels.record_level: Per-isolate reported ED50 and 24-h AUC/MIC ratios; MICs reported as geometric mean of 3; Free drug ratio includes a Mean ± SD row. Groups of two mice per regimen are described, but per-regimen CFU values are not transcribed. No individual-animal observations are established.
labels.drug: Voriconazole; Fluconazole is a comparator MIC drug
labels.endpoint_window: Kidneys removed "at the end of therapy"; other isolates: "for the 24-h study period"; the K-1 section gives no explicit duration. Reported AUC/MIC ratios are labeled 24-h.
labels.reason: The body contains isolate MICs, reported ED50s and total/free AUC/MIC ratios, with infection-model and dosing context. These support partial input coverage for the linked requirements. They do not establish matched per-regimen exposure-response records, measured free concentration profiles, a target definition or an eligible common record set. The reported parameters are not individual animals or measured CFU observations. Fluconazole MICs remain comparator data. Source provenance is S02, DOI 10.1128/AAC.47.10.3165-3169.2003, Table 1.

evidence.quote: Voriconazole efficacy against 10 C. albicans isolates, disseminated candidiasis model

Neutropenic mice as in the PK block; 0.1 ml inoculum (10^4.8-10^5.9 CFU/ml) via the lateral tail vein 2 h before therapy. findings.reason: UNRESOLVED: F0003:S1:T5 provides source provenance, isolate-level MICs and reported parameters, and group-size and regimen notes. It does not provide individual-animal observations, transcribed per-regimen CFU records, an exposure assay, exposure matrix or complete dose and sampling histories. These gaps do not establish absence elsewhere. MI005 remains DEFERRED until the authorized preparation assessment, as specified in this requirement.
findings.needed_material: Authorized preparation assessment of source-linked records, retaining reported-parameter and summary status, missing fields and the stated kidney CFU detection limit.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED: F0003:S1:T5:A53 explicitly leaves the PD dosing route unstated; oral gavage describes PK only. The lateral tail vein in A52 is the inoculation route. Total and Free drug ratios are separate, but exposure matrix, assay, free-exposure derivation and treatment-day linkage are not stated. The K-1 section has no explicit duration.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported PD administration route, exposure provenance and treatment-day context; preserve unknown fields and avoid transferring the PK route or duration to PD without evidence.

findings.reason: MI010, Eligible matched PK/PD records, remains DEFERRED with resolution_status OPEN and needed_at index, originating in main:/missing_information/items/9. Comparable index regressions and supported targets cannot yet be established. F0003:S1:T5 has row-associated isolate MICs and reported ED50/AUC/MIC values, but A54 states that per-regimen CFU values are in figures only and not transcribed. DRQ021 therefore remains UNRESOLVED; this page does not establish regimen-specific matched exposures and responses or a common comparison record set.
findings.needed_material: Establish eligible matched records for each organism and endpoint under SC017, SC032 and SC033, or document why an index or target is not determinable. Preserve response identifiers, isolate MICs, exposure provenance, free basis, histories and windows. This does not block independent animal PK work.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED: A52-A54 supply neutropenia, inoculum, intravenous inoculation timing, kidney endpoint, dose/interval contrasts and NCCLS M27-A MICs at 48 h with geometric mean of 3. Mouse strain, MIC medium and inhibition endpoint, the nature of the three MIC measurements, response reference point, untreated growth controls and full separate-PK compatibility are not established. Frequency variation is described for K-1; other isolates use every 6 h. The effect of this design on index distinguishability remains unassessed.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported missing infection-model, susceptibility-test and PK-to-PD compatibility metadata; retain isolate-specific design differences for downstream assessment without imposing a regimen-count threshold.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED: E55:F65 report total and free 24-h AUC/MIC ratios by isolate. They do not establish raw free AUC inputs, AUC units, time origin, binding derivation, exposure matrix, treatment day or per-regimen exposure-response links. The 24-h label does not resolve the explicit lack of a K-1 treatment duration.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported free AUC inputs or a documented planned derivation from eligible PK records, with units, window origin, regimen/day and matched response linkage.

findings.reason: MISSING within this reviewed item: no free Cmax input, peak definition or peak-response linkage is supplied. Reported AUC/MIC ratios do not establish these inputs.
findings.needed_material: Assess authorized sources for free Cmax inputs or a planned derivation, preserving peak definition, concentration units, window, regimen and matched response records.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED: isolate MICs are available, but this page contains no free concentration-time input, time-above-MIC window, duration-versus-percentage definition or denominator. AUC/MIC ratios alone cannot establish fT>MIC inputs.
findings.needed_material: Source-linked free profiles or eligible planned derivations, matched MIC thresholds, analysis-window origins and the specified duration or percentage definition.

findings.reason: MI011, Prespecified PK/PD index selection rule, remains NOT_FOUND with resolution_status OPEN and needed_at index, originating in main:/missing_information/items/10. Index comparison cannot proceed with a fully registered selection procedure. This page supplies reported ED50s and AUC/MIC ratios, not the prespecified procedure required by DRQ026.
findings.needed_material: Register the selection rule before index fitting while preserving SC032: equal eligibility for all three indices and both regression families, common matched inputs and likelihood, extra Hill parameter accounting, planned R²/AIC/BIC/stability/identifiability reporting, and no forced winner or selection by R² alone.

findings.reason: D56:F66 contain published ED50s and exposure-index parameters, including a summary Free drug AUC/MIC ratio. Their availability does not authorize primary-analysis starting values, bounds, priors, index rankings or target adoption under R012 and SC035.
findings.needed_material: Independent review of downstream parameter-use provenance and human review before fitting; retain these values as source-reported parameters.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED: A53 defines change in log10 CFU per pair of kidneys and its detection limit, but the desired effect, change reference, untreated controls and matched response inputs are not supplied. Other isolates have a stated 24-h study period; K-1 has no explicit duration. A reported ED50 does not define the project's desired CFU effect. Numerical target estimation remains a planned T004 output rather than automatically missing data.
findings.needed_material: Specify the desired organism-specific CFU effect, baseline/control reference, treatment and observation window, and matched estimation inputs. Keep CFU targets separate from survival targets and other organisms.

findings.reason: A52 uses Isolate K-1 while A56 uses K1. Both original spellings are preserved; their equivalence has not been independently established by an explicit identifier mapping on this page.
findings.needed_material: Confirm the source-supported identifier mapping before attaching the K-1 regimen description to the K1 table row.
